sectionTitle: What changed beyond the sales office

primary.headline: From New Construction to Road Closures: 3 Hays County Transportation Updates
primary.summary: Community Impact rounds up three active Hays County road projects tied to corridor growth: a $19.9-21.6M widening of Center Street in Kyle (sidewalks, lighting, a roundabout; construction began July 13, 2026, running through summer 2027), a $3.4M Sessom Creek slope stabilization at Canyon Road in San Marcos, and a $10.2M Canyon Road paving project (fall 2026-fall 2027). Much of the funding traces to the 2022 Kyle Road Bond.
primary.buyerImplication: Buyers evaluating new-construction communities in the Kyle/San Marcos corridor should expect construction-related traffic and access disruptions into 2027 on and near Center Street and Canyon Road, but the road-bond-funded investment signals continued public infrastructure support for growth in those areas.
primary.buyerAction: Ask a builder or agent about construction timelines and access routes for any community near Center Street, Canyon Road, or Sessom Creek in Kyle/San Marcos before purchasing.
primary.confidence: High confidence -- Community Impact reporting, published 2026-08-27; re-verified 2026-09-18, held for a 15th day after a fresh search pass found no fresher qualifying story (results returned only the standing story itself and seven older roundups, Jan-Jul 2026). Recency score nudged down another point as the story ages (now 22 days old); it still clears the 70-point publish bar at 76. Construction timelines are as stated in the source article.
